newsitem.title: UK: UK's Blair meets Mandela and pledges education aid.
newsitem.headline: UK's Blair meets Mandela and pledges education aid.

text.p: British Prime Minister Tony Blair on Thursday welcomed President Nelson Mandela to his London office and promised him help with better education for South Africans.
Blair's office said in a statement released after their Downing Street meeting that Britain was to provide bursaries for 1,000 South Africans to follow higher education courses.
Blair also told Mandela that his new government was giving South Africa 10 million pounds ($16.8 million) in aid for basic education, primary health care and provision of clean water.
Dozens of British schoolchildren greeted 78-year-old Mandela as he arrived for the meeting. He chatted with the youngsters, shook their hands and signed autographs.

Mandela is on a four-day private visit to Britain. Much of the coverage of his trip in the British press has focused on his travelling companion and sweetheart Graca Machel, widow of the former Mozambican president Samora Machel.
